profile.headline: Software Engineer at Upstage
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer who loves to make things, especially software. Making things are so much fun and polishing them in terms of the reasonable code and the sustainable structure is another level of excitement which I'm so passionate.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Dev Environments (Infra tooling)
* Maintenance for a remote development VS Code plug-in
* Prototyped the next Android development workflow for Facebook
* Enhanced a few workflows which enables a dynamic/on-demand dev environment

Assistant Team
* Designed and implemented an ondevice test automation for voice assistant services and its applications
* Implemented an assistant pub/sub application protocol on top of http2+extension to drive a test automation (Go service, Android, iOS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Working in the front-end applications for the sell-side firm / brokers.
* Implement various UI elements for the next generation order management system
* Technical lead for order-import application (Typescript, Redux, in-house application framework). Designed/implemented the architecture and data flow overall the application/backend service. Typescript, in-house UI platform, Redux
* Developed report generation module for post transaction cost analysis project. Javascript
* Maintained frontend(Javascript) and backend(C++) legacy program for sell-side order management system.
* Developed several utility tools for the development tooling. Typescript, Javascript.

positions.title: Founder, Lead Developer
positions.description:
* Designed, developed a desktop application named "FramerFlow" for Framer.js powered prototyping on Windows platform(http://www.framerflow.com). For the sharing feature and API backend is developed on Clojure.
* Designed, developed Counter gear app which won 3rd prize in Samsung Gear App Challenge. (Clojurescript, WebGL)
* Designed, developed MomentCollection for Tizen mobile device which won 2nd prize in Tizen App Challenge(Javascript, React.js, and Angular.js).
* Developed Windows Phone, Windows 8 applications – Ribbon, Helicopter game, Skybox (C#, In-house 3D renderer in Javascript)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and developed single page web apps such Nike Running(Knockout.js), Voxer(C++/Lua), Spotify(C++,React.js,Redux), CameraAce(Javascript,Clojurescript) on Tizen platform.  
* Designed and developed backend servers such as news feeding service(Node.js), news crawler(Python, MySQL), user authentication service(Clojure, MySQL), and photo slideshow service(Clojure).
* Developed mobile applications for Windows Mobile, Windows Phone using C/C++, C#, Rx. Most of the applications are preloaded on Samsung devices.
* Developed Wordpress based web-site for www.samsungdevelopers.com in PHP. SugaCRM integration work.
* Solid understanding and proved work experiences for making a reliable and performant multi-threading applications and services by utilizing Rx(C#), RxJs(JavaScript), Clojure(go style channel), and in-house CSP style channel libraries(C++).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Ported Intel-BSP for PXA25x, PXA27x application CPU to Samsung mobile hardware.
* Developed device drivers for various mobile phone part–keypad, backlight, power management, etc.
* Built Operating System Image for Samsung mobile devices.

positions.title: Teacher’s Assistant
positions.description:
* Assisted the Professor’s lecture and examining students’ works. 
* Created computer science problems for students to solve.
* Showed Computer Laboratory simulations for students.

positions.title: Application Developer (Contractor)
positions.description:
* Designed and developed digital book software for a real-estate lawyer.
* Integrated and programmed “Search Tool” for old cases and history with VB/VC++

positions.title: Mobile Game Developer(Contractor)
positions.description:
* Ported Windows Mobile 'Bubble Smile' based game to J2ME platform.
* Supplied the game on Samsung's feature phone in the U.S., Europe, and Mideast market.
* https://www.google.com/search?q=bubblesmile&source=lnms&tbm=isch&sa=X&ved=0ahUKEwjb6IqL2t7PAhVD5mMKHagbCMYQ_AUICigD&biw=1706&bih=840

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed dental patient image management and processing including intra-oral camera, calibration , measuring tool and digital x-ray.
* Designed & implemented application framework based on COM plugin.
* Designed and implemented bill payment computation module
* Designed and implemented real-time reservation system based on XML-RPC
* Used C++/VC++/ATL/WTL/XML/LeadTools/MSDE2000 program and languages

honors.title: Samsung Gear App Challenge
honors.description:
* 3rd prize winner
* Counter - Count daily routine and create better environment for your dream!
* http://devpost.com/software/counter-count-check-change-4ay8f
* Developed with Clojurescript/WebGL/Pixi

honors.title: Tizen App Challenge
honors.description:
* 2nd prize winner - https://developer.tizen.org/contests/tizen-app-challenge/lifestyle-health-navigation-travel
* Your Private Journal Application. Write your story and organize whatever you feel make you better. Beautifully designed, and well-organized app gives you better digital journal experience.
* Developed note application for Samsung's Tizen platform
* Single page web application which is developed with AngularJS & SASS
* https://youtu.be/1kf6R3s-PJM

projects.title: FramerFlow
projects.description:
FramerFlow is a powerful editor for better prototyping with Framer.js on Windows platform. I have designed and developed FramerFlow(http://www.framerflow.com) application and service. Still under the alpha stage, but it is useful.
The app is built on Electron and also developed with Clojure/Clojurescript/Node.js/React.j.s.

projects.title: Counter
projects.description: The app is only for counting daily your routine. You can count, track and measure how your daily routines go well. Those regular routines can create much better and powerful environment for you. We also provide famous artists, musicians, philosophers and writer's daily routine. Those creative minds breathe, eat, work and sleep just like your life. So you can pick one of them and make it yours. The app is beautifully designed and provide fantastic counting experience.
